column6: Both paragraphs convey the same message about the necessity of active participation and discipline in both physical fitness and faith to fully realize the benefits of membership, without any significant changes in meaning.
column7: It takes more than a gym membership to make a person healthy and physically fit. You must continue in the discipline of the gym to get the full benefits of membership. Likewise, we cannot merely attend a church or casually claim to be Christians, we all must become educated, trained, equipped, disciplined in the faith, only then will we realize the full benefits of membership!
column8: Gym membership alone is not enough for a person to become healthy and physically fit. Rather, one must continue in the discipline of the gym to obtain the full benefits of membership. Likewise، we cannot be content with attending church or the passing claim that we are Christians؛ rather, we must all learn, train, be equipped, and be disciplined in the faith, and only then will we receive the full benefits of membership!
